test_m2 = '''"""Tests for milestone m2: bump_build appends .0 for non-numeric last segment."""


def test_m2_alpha():
    """When build ends with non-purely-numeric segment like 'alpha', append '.0'."""
    import semver
    v = semver.Version.parse("1.2.3+alpha")
    result = v.bump_build()
    assert str(result) == "1.2.3+alpha.0"


def test_m2_build_dot_9():
    """Numeric last segment still increments normally."""
    import semver
    v = semver.Version.parse("1.2.3+build.9")
    result = v.bump_build()
    assert str(result) == "1.2.3+build.10"

    """Version with both prerelease and build metadata works correctly."""
    import semver
    v = semver.Version.parse("3.4.5-rc.1+build.9")
    result = v.bump_build()
    assert str(result) == "3.4.5-rc.1+build.10"
